paper_metadata.title: Microstructures evolution, texture characteristics and mechanical properties of extruded Mg-9Gd-3Nd-1Zn-1Sn-0.5Zr alloy

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: a comprehensive investigation was conducted to explore the microstructural evolution, texture characteristics, and mechanical properties of extruded Mg-9Gd-3Nd-1Zn-1Sn-0.5Zr alloys with varying extrusion ratios(ERs).

evidence.section: 2. Experimental procedure
evidence.quote: the as-cast alloy underwent a homogenization process at 525°C for 10 h, followed by a cooling phase in hot water at 70°C to enhance its homogeneity.

evidence.section: 2. Experimental procedure
evidence.quote: Subsequently, the ingots were turned form a diameter of 100 mm to 80 mm, and the oxide skin and casting defects were removed from the material’s surface. These segments were then introduced into an extrusion machine, where they were transformed into bars with diameters of 40 mm, 20 mm, and 16 mm, all extruded at a rate of 2 m/min.
